plain: To come back as a result, such as credit or blame

webster.text: To be sent, rolled or driven back.

more.text: To proceed in the consequence or effect; to result.

example.quote: The maxim that the consumer is the payer, is so much oftener true than the reverse of the proposition, that it is far more equitable that the duties on imports should go into a common stock, than that they should redound to the exclusive benefit of the importing States.
